title: Maximum Number of Visible Points
constraints: Point and location coordinates are integers in [-10^4, 10^4]
Duplicate point coordinates are allowed and count as separate points
inputFormat: Implement visiblePoints(points, angle, location). Receive [x, y] point pairs, a field-of-view angle in degrees, and your fixed [x, y] location.
outputFormat: Return the maximum number of points visible simultaneously over all viewing directions.
